text.strays_intro: A stray puppy and a stray kitten are hiding in the park. They look hungry and scared.
text.stray_friendly: The stray @1 wags up to you.
text.no_treats: It sniffs your hand. Pet Treats would win it over: Drifter Woods sells them, by the Brownstones.
text.fed_first: The @1 gobbles up the treat. Come back tomorrow!
text.fed_today: The @1 is full for today. Come back tomorrow.
text.trusts: The @1 trusts you now! You can take it home.
text.adopted: You adopted the @1! It's in your Pockets: let it loose at home.
text.other_adopted: @1 adopted the stray @2. It found a home too!
